tools.name: dotypos_list_branches
tools.description: List the branches (shops / points of sale) of the connected Dotypos cloud. Use the ids to filter orders, reservations and reports. GET /clouds/{cloud}/branches.

tools.name: dotypos_get_branch
tools.description: One branch by id. GET /clouds/{cloud}/branches/{id}.

tools.name: dotypos_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories (name, VAT, colour, sort order). GET /clouds/{cloud}/categories.

tools.name: dotypos_get_category
tools.description: One product category by id. GET /clouds/{cloud}/categories/{id}.

tools.name: dotypos_list_products
tools.description: List or search the product catalog: name, prices with and without VAT, VAT, category, EAN/PLU codes, unit, tags, stock-deduction setting. Filter by name text, category, EAN or PLU code, tag or visibility. GET /clouds/{cloud}/products.

tools.name: dotypos_get_product
tools.description: One product by id with all its fields (prices, VAT, codes, allergens, packaging, notes). GET /clouds/{cloud}/products/{id}.

tools.name: dotypos_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers (name, company, email, phone, address, points, tags). All given filters must match. Contains personal data. GET /clouds/{cloud}/customers.

tools.name: dotypos_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id. Contains personal data. GET /clouds/{cloud}/customers/{id}.

tools.name: dotypos_list_orders
tools.description: List orders and receipts (documents): number, type, status, totals, customer, employee, table, branch, paid flag, created/completed dates. Filter by time, status, type, branch, customer, employee or paid state; newest first by default. Line items are in dotypos_list_order_items. GET /clouds/{cloud}/

tools.name: dotypos_get_order
tools.description: One order / receipt by id: status, totals, document number, customer, employee, table, notes, tags. GET /clouds/{cloud}/orders/{id}.

tools.name: dotypos_list_order_items
tools.description: List sold line items: product, name, quantity, unit prices before and after discount, VAT, category, employee, order. Give order_id for one order's lines, or a time range for sales analysis. GET /clouds/{cloud}/order-items.

tools.name: dotypos_get_sales_report
tools.description: The base sales report of one branch for a time range of at most 26 hours (one business day; Dotypos limits a report to 26 hours, so ask for one day at a time): sales and cancel counts and values, revenue with VAT and payment-type breakdown, discounts, cash in/out, sales by category, product, tag, em

tools.name: dotypos_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (name, e-mail, phone, enabled flag, access levels). Login barcodes and PINs are never returned. GET /clouds/{cloud}/employees.

tools.name: dotypos_list_tables
tools.description: List restaurant tables: name, location, seats, branch, enabled flag. GET /clouds/{cloud}/tables.

tools.name: dotypos_list_reservations
tools.description: List table reservations: customer, table, branch, start and end time, seats, status, note. Filter by start time window, branch or customer; each reservation carries its status (NEW, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED). GET /clouds/{cloud}/reservations.

tools.name: dotypos_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (stock locations). Use the ids with dotypos_list_stock. GET /clouds/{cloud}/warehouses.

tools.name: dotypos_list_stock
tools.description: Stock status of the products in one warehouse: each product with its quantity on hand (stockQuantityStatus), last stock change and purchase price. Filter by name or by maximum quantity to find low stock. GET /clouds/{cloud}/warehouses/{id}/products.

tools.name: dotypos_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (name, company ids, contact and address). GET /clouds/{cloud}/suppliers.

tools.name: dotypos_list_delivery_notes
tools.description: List imported supplier delivery notes: document number, supplier, branch, dates, status, download URL. GET /clouds/{cloud}/delivery-notes.

tools.name: dotypos_list_tags
tools.description: List tags used on products, customers and orders. GET /clouds/{cloud}/tags.

tools.name: dotypos_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer record. At least one of first_name, last_name or company_name is required. Creates a new record every time (not idempotent). POST /clouds/{cloud}/customers.

tools.name: dotypos_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one customer; only the fields you pass are changed. The record is read first and updated with its ETag, so a concurrent change makes the update fail instead of overwriting it. PATCH /clouds/{cloud}/customers/{id}.

tools.name: dotypos_update_product
tools.description: WRITE: change the name, net price, description or visibility of one product; only the fields you pass are changed. The price with VAT is derived by Dotypos from the net price and the product's VAT. The record is read first and updated with its ETag, so a concurrent change makes the update fail. PATC

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dotypos_list_customers, dotypos_list_delivery_notes · Private data: dotypos_list_orders, dotypos_get_order, dotypos_list_suppliers, dotypos_list_delivery_notes, dotypos_create_customer, dotypos_update_customer, dotypos_update_product · Public sink: dotypos_list_customers, dotypos_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dotypos_list_customers, dotypos_list_delivery_notes · Private data: dotypos_list_orders, dotypos_get_order, dotypos_list_suppliers, dotypos_list_delivery_notes, dotypos_create_customer, dotypos_update_customer, dotypos_update_product · Public sink: dotypos_list_customers, dotypos_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
